title: Actual slice restriction and normalized completed comparison data
statement: With the sites, rings and derived operations of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] and the raw rational categories of [def-sf-raw-rational-slice-coefficients], define a restriction arrow $U\to V$ to be the unique direct restriction if $U$ is global, no arrow from a slice to global, and a structural map $V\to U$ between slices. Its site functor is identity, forgetful or composition respectively, and its module functor is actual sectionwise restriction. Restrict complexes termwise and derive this exact functor; the localization comparison is its specified derived-factorization map. Restrict completed units by their section identities and degree-zero derived comparison, and extend restriction to raw scalar-localized morphisms. A completed restriction comparison datum comprises preservation of good representatives, reduction, product, Roos-cone, completion, ordinary and completed tensor, ambient Hom and coefficient-unit isomorphisms. Normalized means the reduction tensor-generator and transition and unit equations, product-projection equations, both Roos-coordinate equations, good-representative completion computation and unit equations, completed-tensor comparison equation, and equality with the actual restricted-unit map. Coherent means these data satisfy composition and identity equations using the actual sectionwise restriction transports. This defines data and predicates; it makes no assertion that such data exist.
